d: Germany is transforming its military, investing in long-range missiles and defence capabilities as Europe prepares for an uncertain security environment. But its ability to strike deep inside Russia raises a difficult question: how can Europe strengthen deterrence without risking nuclear escalation? France is pressing Berlin to align its conventional strike plans with an understanding of nuclear doctrine.
